## 改动与验证 / Changes and testing

请简述改动和验证方式。Describe what changed and how you checked it.

## 贡献授权 / Contribution rights

提交原创代码或文档时，请确认你有权按本项目的 MIT 许可证提供这些改动。
For original code or documentation, confirm that you can contribute the changes under the project’s MIT License.

如果新增或替换第三方图片、字体或数据，请列出文件路径、来源、权利人、允许公开再分发的许可依据及需要保留的署名，并更新相应的素材声明。
For new or replaced third-party images, fonts or data, give the file path, source, rights holder, basis for public redistribution and required credits. Update the corresponding asset notice.
